title: DojoLiq Blue Razz Lemonade 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Dive into the vibrant profile of Vaporesso DojoLiq Blue Razz Lemonade, a sparkling fruit beverage blend that truly excites the palate. The profile begins with the deep, tangy sweetness of Blue Raspberry, delivering a bold berry punch. This is immediately lifted by a zesty Lemonade finish, adding a layer of citrus sparkle that makes every puff feel brisk and enlivening. This Nicotine Salt e-liquid is mixed to an exact 43% VG / 57% PG ratio, a bespoke split chosen to maximise the specific flavour saturation and wicking speed for this recipe. The result is a crystal-clear taste profile suitable for any MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vape kit. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, it offers a smooth draw and efficient nicotine delivery. Brought to you by the hardware specialists at Vaporesso, the DojoLiq collection captures the vibrant, authentic flavours of their popular Dojo series in a versatile 10ml format. These e-liquids offer rapid nicotine satisfaction and consistently bold taste from the first drop to the last.
